title: Promotion analytics and outbound links
description: One small script sends view_promotion once per unit (50% visible for 1 s) and select_promotion on click. Each event carries the standard promotion fields plus topic, match kind and action. Every sponsored link gets rel='sponsored noopener' and UTMs. Extend the reader privacy scan to cover the new events.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Live 2026-10-25 (Shipped #94, Amplify job 84; Ryan approved the copy and links). select_promotion verified on the live site with the design's fields and no reader identity. view_promotion verified in headless Chrome with live styles: one event per unit, only once it is on screen. rel='sponsored noopener' and UTMs are on every sponsored link. The reader privacy scan covers the new events.
